EIGHT GENRES · YOUR ORDER

A whole world of chapters.

Your favorite first. A new genre after every completed collection.

The bigger the hit, the rarer the drop. Common → Uncommon → Rare → Epic → Legendary. Recognition tiers are curated for this prototype; they are not live Spotify streaming scores. Legendary songs have the lowest random drop weight. Each song appears only once on the map within its genre. Collected songs do not spawn again.
